name: Friendship / Brotherhood (Ukhuwwah)

definition_by_age.4: Being a good friend and playing nicely together.
definition_by_age.6: Friendship means caring about your friends and treating them the way you want to be treated.
definition_by_age.8: Ukhuwwah means the bond between believers — supporting, forgiving, and standing by your friends, especially when it's hard.

learning_objective: Children can describe one way to be a good friend when a friend is having a hard time.
notes: New concept file created 2026-08-05 — confirmed via search that concept_community covers the global Ummah, not personal peer friendship, before creating this as distinct. No evidence attached yet at creation time.
